thesis: Fireball is flexible because mana can become direct damage, creature removal, or divided damage, but its unusual division cost rewards precise calculation.

playbook.role: Count the extra mana required for multiple targets and decide whether preserving the spell as a finisher is worth passing an earlier removal opportunity. Mana doublers and Channel turn its variable cost into a combo engine.
